caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, ornately decorated Punch and Judy puppet bank with a detailed front and a simplified side view. The main structure is a box with a red scalloped top, blue curtains held by yellow ropes, and lattice-patterned red side panels. The upper section displays a yellow sign bordered in red with the words "PUNCH AND JUDY BANK" in bold black letters. Inside the puppet stage are two figures: one is a pale gray figure with a red hat and a neutral expression, while the other is a colorful clown-like figure with a yellow face, red and yellow hat, ruffled white collar, and red costume, holding a brown stick. The lower front panel is yellow with a central red, blue, and yellow geometric starburst design bordered by red semicircles. Below and to the right, there is a smaller, monochromatic pink sketch in simplified form showing a side and back view of the same bank structure. The background is a plain off-white color, and in small red letters the name "DOROTHEE BATES" is printed below the main illustration.
title: Mechanical Bank: Punch and Judy
